source_text: 离我远点！

text: Uhhh?
source_text: Uhhh?

text: 嗯？
source_text: 嗯？

source_text: #Geez. You're worse off than I am, friend. Luck to you.

text: #Oh, kind of ya, friend. Very kind. You know, if I could clear the gunk out of there, you, just might find a tear in Old Harold's eye.
source_text: #Oh, kind of ya, friend. Very kind. You know, if I could clear the gunk out of there, you, just might find a tear in Old Harold's eye.

text: Why is that?
source_text: Why is that?

source_text: 怎么会这么感动啊？

text: You're welcome.
source_text: You're welcome.

text: 不客气。
source_text: 不客气。

text: #【Cough】 Rest of the Hubbers' been picking on me like a bad booger since I came back to town.  I can't leave, though.  When the deals are done 【wheez】 it's still my home.
source_text: #【Cough】 Rest of the Hubbers' been picking on me like a bad booger since I came back to town.  I can't leave, though.  When the deals are done 【wheez】 it's still my home.

text: 【咳嗽】自从我回到这个镇子那些哈勃仔把我像垃圾一样对待。但我不能走。虽然受了不少奚落，【喘气】但这里还是我的家啊。
source_text: 【咳嗽】自从我回到这个镇子那些哈勃仔把我像垃圾一样对待。但我不能走。虽然受了不少奚落，【喘气】但这里还是我的家啊。

text: What happened to you?
source_text: What happened to you?

text: 你怎么了？
source_text: 你怎么了？

source_text: Who are the Hubbers?

text: 谁是哈勃仔？
source_text: 谁是哈勃仔？

text: Hope things get better. See you around.
source_text: Hope things get better. See you around.

text: 希望事情会变得更好。再见。
source_text: 希望事情会变得更好。再见。

text: #Well, after the Great War, my Vault was one of the first to open. 【Takes a deep breath】 Whew.  Long time.
source_text: #Well, after the Great War, my Vault was one of the first to open. 【Takes a deep breath】 Whew.  Long time.

text: 好吧，核战后，我的避难所是第一个打开的。【深呼吸】是啊，很久了。
source_text: 好吧，核战后，我的避难所是第一个打开的。【深呼吸】是啊，很久了。

text: Tell me more about those days.
source_text: Tell me more about those days.

text: 告诉我那时的事情。
source_text: 告诉我那时的事情。

text: No, no. I meant what happened to change you?
source_text: No, no. I meant what happened to change you?

text: 不，不是。我的意思是什么让你变成这样的？
source_text: 不，不是。我的意思是什么让你变成这样的？

text: #All started with the sirens.  I was young, but ohh, I do remember that.  Lotta terrible years followed.  And I remember walking outta the Vault late one morning.
source_text: #All started with the sirens.  I was young, but ohh, I do remember that.  Lotta terrible years followed.  And I remember walking outta the Vault late one morning.

text: 所有的事情都是随着打开避难所大门的警报声开始的。我那时候还小，但是，虽然遭了这么多年的罪，我仍然记得当时的事情。我记得我是在一个上午走出避难所的。
source_text: 所有的事情都是随着打开避难所大门的警报声开始的。我那时候还小，但是，虽然遭了这么多年的罪，我仍然记得当时的事情。我记得我是在一个上午走出避难所的。

text: What did you do then?
source_text: What did you do then?

text: 然后呢？
source_text: 然后呢？

text: Where was your Vault located?
source_text: Where was your Vault located?

text: 你的避难所在哪？
source_text: 你的避难所在哪？

text: Do you realize how old that makes you?
source_text: Do you realize how old that makes you?

text: 自那以后过了多久了？
source_text: 自那以后过了多久了？

text: #You know, 【cough】 I'm not real sure anymore.  West, I think.  Uh wait - east?  Ooh I don't know.  【Hacking cough】
source_text: #You know, 【cough】 I'm not real sure anymore.  West, I think.  Uh wait - east?  Ooh I don't know.  【Hacking cough】

text: 你知道，【咳嗽】我记不清了。西边，我想。哦等等--东边？哦我不知道了。【干咳】
source_text: 你知道，【咳嗽】我记不清了。西边，我想。哦等等--东边？哦我不知道了。【干咳】

source_text: What did you do then?

text: 然后呢？
source_text: 然后呢？

text: #Well, I was a trader.  Did pretty good making a circuit between survivors.  Lost a lotta good people, though. 【Coughs】
source_text: #Well, I was a trader.  Did pretty good making a circuit between survivors.  Lost a lotta good people, though. 【Coughs】

text: 好吧，我那时是个商人。我们在幸存者之间捣腾货物，干得还不赖。可是，也折了很多兄弟。【咳嗽】
source_text: 好吧，我那时是个商人。我们在幸存者之间捣腾货物，干得还不赖。可是，也折了很多兄弟。【咳嗽】

text: How?
source_text: How?

text: 他们怎么死的？
source_text: 他们怎么死的？

text: #Gangers got'em.  Scavengers attacking the caravans.  And mutants, son of a dog, if they weren't springing up like rabbits with a mission. 【cough】 Had to have an army of guards with, just to do a deal.
source_text: #Gangers got'em.  Scavengers attacking the caravans.  And mutants, son of a dog, if they weren't springing up like rabbits with a mission. 【cough】 Had to have an army of guards with, just to do a deal.

text: 先是被土匪追杀。后来，拾荒者又抢劫商队。最后是那些变种人，狗娘养的，野兔一样蜂拥而来执行任务。【咳嗽】做什么生意都要雇保镖。
source_text: 先是被土匪追杀。后来，拾荒者又抢劫商队。最后是那些变种人，狗娘养的，野兔一样蜂拥而来执行任务。【咳嗽】做什么生意都要雇保镖。

source_text: 你够笨啊，当然是有用的了！但是变种人太多了！

text: 你怎么幸免于难的？
source_text: 你怎么幸免于难的？

text: #Didn't.  Got killed. 【Laughing cough】 Love that joke.
source_text: #Didn't.  Got killed. 【Laughing cough】 Love that joke.

text: Uh, yeah.
source_text: Uh, yeah.

text: 哦，是啊。
source_text: 哦，是啊。

text: #Everywhere!  Hell, seemed like you couldn't fart without hitting one.  But mostly in the northwest.
source_text: #Everywhere!  Hell, seemed like you couldn't fart without hitting one.  But mostly in the northwest.

source_text: 漫山遍野！日啊，你放个屁就会砸到一只。但主要是从西北方来。

source_text: Why didn't you just avoid the area?

source_text: You farted northwest?

source_text: 你朝西北放屁？

text: 【Laughs】 Pretty good...Noo...
source_text: 【Laughs】 Pretty good...Noo...

text: 【笑】很好笑……当然不是了……
source_text: 【笑】很好笑……当然不是了……

source_text: 我们组织了一支探险队。对了，想起来了，理查德。理查德·格瑞是我们的领袖。

text: 理查德·格瑞？
source_text: 理查德·格瑞？

text: Where exactly did you go?
source_text: Where exactly did you go?

text: 你们去哪里？
source_text: 你们去哪里？

text: #Needed to see what was there.  Maybe stop whatever was churnin them boogers out.  We thought we were prepared.  Were we wrong.
source_text: #Needed to see what was there.  Maybe stop whatever was churnin them boogers out.  We thought we were prepared.  Were we wrong.

text: 你们做了什么？
source_text: 你们做了什么？

source_text: #I can't remember the route or anything.  But I am damn sure it was northwest, though...I think.

text: 我记不得路了。但我确定在西北……我想是的。
source_text: 我记不得路了。但我确定在西北……我想是的。

source_text: Is there a shorter version of this story?

text: 可以简略的说吗？
source_text: 可以简略的说吗？

source_text: What about your leader?

text: 你的领导怎样？
source_text: 你的领导怎样？

source_text: #Richard Grey was a doctor.  Little older than me, and friend was he smart.  He found the source.

source_text: 理查德·格瑞是个医生。比我年纪稍大一点，是个聪明的哥们。他发现了变种人的源头。

source_text: And what was that?

text: 是什么？
source_text: 是什么？

source_text: 我喜欢按自己的意思说。简化版需要你多花25个瓶盖，朋友。同意吗？

text: 两个都不要如何，你这个老屁精？

text: #Well, you seem like an okay sort.  I'll speed it up a bit.

text: 好吧，看来你这个人还行。我会尽快讲完。

text: Thanks.
source_text: Thanks.

text: 谢谢。
source_text: 谢谢。

source_text: Lying to a poor old mutant.  What's the world coming to? 【cough】

source_text: 欺骗一个可怜的老变种人。这个世界怎么了？【咳嗽】

text: 钱不够，嗯？
source_text: 钱不够，嗯？

text: 要么按我的说，要么走开。你选吧，朋友。
source_text: 要么按我的说，要么走开。你选吧，朋友。

text: Walking.
source_text: Walking.

text: 我走了。
source_text: 我走了。

text: OK. Long it is.
source_text: OK. Long it is.

text: 好吧。长的。
source_text: 好吧。长的。

text: #Some sort of old military base.  We lost a lotta folks getting in there.

text: 某个老军事基地。进基地的路上我们失去了很多同伴。

source_text: 你怎么知道这个基地是源头？

source_text: What were you running up against?

text: 你们碰到了什么？
source_text: 你们碰到了什么？

text: #Robots and such.  Lot of'em.  Damn surprised they was still running after all this time, what with the war and all.  Whooa boy they tore us a good one.
source_text: #Robots and such.  Lot of'em.  Damn surprised they was still running after all this time, what with the war and all.  Whooa boy they tore us a good one.

text: 机器人之类的，很多。该死的，这些玩意这么多年来还能用。我们当时被打惨了。
source_text: 机器人之类的，很多。该死的，这些玩意这么多年来还能用。我们当时被打惨了。

source_text: What did you do once you got past the robots?

text: 摆平了机器人后你们都做了什么？
source_text: 摆平了机器人后你们都做了什么？

text: #Because it was like someone went bargain shopping at mutantland!  Geez!  Cheaper by the dozens!  Can't figure any other reason except that being the factory.
source_text: #Because it was like someone went bargain shopping at mutantland!  Geez!  Cheaper by the dozens!  Can't figure any other reason except that being the factory.

text: 就像在变种人的地盘上赶集似的！啊！变种人太多了！肯定是有工厂在做变种人，没有其他原因了。
source_text: 就像在变种人的地盘上赶集似的！啊！变种人太多了！肯定是有工厂在做变种人，没有其他原因了。

text: 你进基地仔细调查过吗？
source_text: 你进基地仔细调查过吗？

text: #We got pretty far inside.  Wasn't a lot of us left by then.  Grey, me and couple of others.
source_text: #We got pretty far inside.  Wasn't a lot of us left by then.  Grey, me and couple of others.

source_text: 我们进的很深。剩下的人不多了。只有格瑞、我和其他几个人了。

text: And then?
source_text: And then?

text: 然后呢？
source_text: 然后呢？

text: #One of them robots got Francine.  Mark was wounded, sent him back to the surface.  Then it was just me and Grey.
source_text: #One of them robots got Francine.  Mark was wounded, sent him back to the surface.  Then it was just me and Grey.

text: 机器人打死了弗朗辛。马克受伤了，被送回了地面。然后只剩下了我和格瑞。
source_text: 机器人打死了弗朗辛。马克受伤了，被送回了地面。然后只剩下了我和格瑞。

text: What ever happened to Mark?
source_text: What ever happened to Mark?

text: 马克后来怎样了？
source_text: 马克后来怎样了？

text: What happened then?
source_text: What happened then?

text: 然后呢？
source_text: 然后呢？

text: #To this day, I don't know.  He never made it back here, and...well I...couldn't face the wasteland again, so I...I never looked.
source_text: #To this day, I don't know.  He never made it back here, and...well I...couldn't face the wasteland again, so I...I never looked.

text: 一直没消息，我也不知道。他从没回来，并且……我……也不敢去废土转悠了，因此我……我从没遇见他过。
source_text: 一直没消息，我也不知道。他从没回来，并且……我……也不敢去废土转悠了，因此我……我从没遇见他过。

text: 那你和格瑞呢？
source_text: 那你和格瑞呢？

source_text: 我们来到了基地中心，有点像厂房的样子。然后不幸发生了。

text: What?
source_text: What?

text: 什么？
source_text: 什么？

source_text: #A robot crane crashed into us.  Last I saw of Grey, he was flying through the air in-into some sort of acid bath.  I was in bad shape and...well I passed out.

source_text: And you never saw Grey again?

text: 你再没见过格瑞？
source_text: 你再没见过格瑞？

text: 没有啊。我死了啊……【笑然后咳嗽】天哪，我喜欢那个笑话。

text: Yeah, I can tell.
